name: minecraft
note: Starting weights: `general`'s set plus two action categories for SMP/hardcore-style content (near_death_escape, pvp_or_mob_fight). No Minecraft-specific view data yet; split into its own file so it re-weights only from Minecraft campaigns' own posts. Re-weighted from our own clips' view counts once there are enough (PRD section 6).

categories.description: A close call where the player nearly dies or loses everything, and survives or doesn't.
A fight against another player or a mob, with the outcome visible.
A clear setup followed by a payoff inside the clip.
Something unexpected happens that the viewer could not predict.
A loud or visible reaction: shouting, laughter, shock.
One line people would repeat or comment.
What is at risk is stated in the first three seconds.

penalties.description: Makes no sense without the rest of the stream, or depends on a long running storyline.
Nothing happens in the first three seconds.
